        have h₂ : k = 0 := by omega

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem choose_boundary_pascal (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)  :
  Nat.choose n k = if k = 0 then 1 else Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) := by
  have h₁ : Nat.choose n k = if k = 0 then 1 else Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) := by
    split_ifs with hk
    · 
      simp_all [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.sub_self]
      <;> aesop
    · 
      have h₂ : n ≥ 1 := by omega
      have h₃ : k ≤ n ∨ k > n := by omega
      cases h₃ with
      | inl h₃ =>
        
        have h₄ : Nat.choose n k = Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) := by
          have h₅ : n ≥ 1 := by omega
          have h₆ : k ≤ n := by omega
          cases k with
          | zero =>
            contradiction
          | succ k' =>
            cases n with
            | zero =>
              contradiction
            | succ n' =>
              simp_all [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> omega
        rw [h₄]
      | inr h₃ =>
        
        have h₄ : Nat.choose n k = 0 := by
          apply Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt
          <;> omega
        rw [h₄]
        have h₅ : Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = 0 := by
          have h₆ : n ≥ 1 := by omega
          have h₇ : k > n := by omega
          have h₈ : k - 1 ≥ n - 1 ∨ k - 1 < n - 1 := by omega
          cases h₈ with
          | inl h₈ =>
            
            have h₉ : Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = 0 := by
              apply Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt
              <;> omega
            have h₁₀ : Nat.choose (n - 1) k = 0 := by
              apply Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt
              <;> omega
            simp_all [h₉, h₁₀]
          | inr h₈ =>
            
            have h₉ : Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = 0 := by
              apply Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt
              <;> omega
            have h₁₀ : Nat.choose (n - 1) k = 0 := by
              apply Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt
              <;> omega
            simp_all [h₉, h₁₀]
        omega
  exact h₁
